rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for land and buildings as property or as a business sector.

example.english: My older brother has worked in real estate for ten years.
example.traditional: 我阿哥喺地產公司做咗十年。
example.jyutping: ngo5 aa3 go1 hai2 dei6 caan2 gung1 si1 zou6 zo2 sap6 nin4

rows.note: Use this when focusing on a property or properties as assets, especially in business or investment contexts.

example.english: The company plans to buy several properties as a real estate investment and sell them when rents rise.
example.traditional: 公司打算買入幾個物業，等租金升先放售。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 daa2 syun3 maai5 jap6 gei2 go3 mat6 jip6 dang2 zou1 gam1 sing1 sin1 fong3 sau6
